Definition.Name: Customer onboarding orchestration
Definition.Summary: Turn approved customer demand into a governed onboarding motion with explicit commercial intake, staffing review, kickoff approval, and durable sidecar resources.
Definition.ValueStatement: Reduce handoff loss across sales, staffing, approval, and kickoff preparation.
Definition.InterfaceContractSummary: Sales hands over to delivery through explicit contracts and approval gates.
Definition.GovernanceNotes: All external commitments require accountable owner review before kickoff.
Definition.ChangeSummary: Refreshed to keep the current lighter baseline scenario while enriching roles, artifacts, checklists, and validations around the same three-step spine.
Definition.GovernancePolicySummary: Kickoff readiness depends on explicit policy, accountability, and evidence retention.
Definition.ConstitutionRuleSummary: Policy decisions stay explicit and reviewable.
Definition.OperatingModeSummary: Manual and guarded autonomy are both supported depending on step criticality.
Definition.SimulationReadinessSummary: Seed pack models the same typed steps used in runtime validation.

Roles.Purpose: Own the customer-facing commercial context for onboarding and keep success criteria explicit before staffing or kickoff commitments are made.
Roles.StaffingIntent: A customer-facing owner who can confirm commercial priority, named stakeholders, and outcome expectations without bypassing delivery feasibility checks.
Roles.SnapshotSummary: Commercial owner for onboarding priority, stakeholder alignment, and acceptance timing.

Roles.Purpose: Validate whether the required people, environments, and sequencing exist to deliver onboarding without hidden bottlenecks.
Roles.StaffingIntent: An internal owner who can commit or deny staffing, negotiate sequencing, and surface delivery-side readiness risk.
Roles.SnapshotSummary: Capacity and staffing authority for onboarding sequencing and kickoff feasibility.

Roles.Purpose: Run the kickoff decision point so participants leave with explicit owners, timeline, risks, and next actions.
Roles.StaffingIntent: A facilitation-capable implementation lead who can challenge ambiguity before the customer-facing kickoff is accepted as complete.
Roles.SnapshotSummary: Meeting and execution lead for onboarding kickoff and first-phase alignment.

Steps.Title: Capture commercial intake
Steps.Subtitle: Demand handoff and initial delivery framing
Steps.Notes: Turn signed demand into a typed onboarding brief with explicit stakeholders, target dates, constraints, and acceptance intent.
Steps.InputContractSummary: Signed scope, target dates, stakeholder summary, and customer expectations.
Steps.OutputContractSummary: Typed intake packet ready for delivery and staffing review.
Steps.EvidenceContractSummary: Scope summary, named stakeholders, and decision-ready onboarding notes.
Steps.DecisionRightsSummary: Account owner can prepare intake but cannot commit delivery without review.
Steps.ExceptionPolicySummary: Escalate immediately if customer commitments are implied rather than explicit.

RoleAssignments.RebindPolicySummary: Rebind to another commercial owner if the original owner changes.

ArtifactExpectations.Title: Customer onboarding brief
ArtifactExpectations.AllowedFutureUsageSummary: Reusable for staffing review, kickoff, and retrospective analysis.
ArtifactExpectations.ValidationRequirementSummary: Must identify success criteria, stakeholders, target dates, constraints, and unresolved dependencies.

Steps.Title: Review staffing intent
Steps.Subtitle: Capacity and fallback decision
Steps.Notes: Validate the proposed onboarding staffing path, named specialists, and fallback plan before kickoff approval.
Steps.OutputContractSummary: Recommended staffing path with explicit fallback and coverage gaps.
Steps.EvidenceContractSummary: Candidate list, allocation picture, and fallback recommendation.
Steps.DecisionRightsSummary: Staffing manager recommends; governance owner approves kickoff readiness.
Steps.ExceptionPolicySummary: Do not treat partial staffing assumptions as committed staffing.

RoleAssignments.RebindPolicySummary: Rebind to another staffing manager if allocation changes.
Delivery lead review stays explicit even if the assigned person changes.

ArtifactExpectations.Title: Staffing recommendation
ArtifactExpectations.AllowedFutureUsageSummary: Reusable for kickoff approval and onboarding retrospectives.
ArtifactExpectations.ValidationRequirementSummary: Reviewer must confirm role-fit, availability, and fallback coverage.

Steps.Title: Approve kickoff readiness
Steps.Subtitle: Formal onboarding launch gate
Steps.Notes: Approve or reject kickoff readiness using staffing evidence, goals, milestones, and named owners.
Steps.InputContractSummary: Staffing recommendation and draft kickoff plan.
Steps.EvidenceContractSummary: Approval record and managed kickoff artifacts.
Steps.DecisionRightsSummary: Kickoff lead can approve, block, or refuse unsafe launch.
Steps.ExceptionPolicySummary: Reject kickoff when ownership, milestones, or dependencies remain vague.

RoleAssignments.RebindPolicySummary: Approval remains attached to the role, not the current person.

ArtifactExpectations.Title: Kickoff approval record
ArtifactExpectations.AllowedFutureUsageSummary: Reusable for customer review, onboarding execution, and future audits.
ArtifactExpectations.ValidationRequirementSummary: Approval rationale must be explicit and reviewable.

Warnings: Detailed sidecar metadata remains in the process-template pack files.
